mapper.select:
SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF SET ARITHIGNORE ON SET ARITHABORT OFF;
WITH TEMP1 AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.SUN) AS ROWNUM , A.JUNPYOID , A.KERATYPE , A.SUN , CASE A.KERATYPE WHEN '입고' THEN A.MAIPCHER WHEN '출고' THEN A.J_COMPANY END AS DEALER_NM , A.J_BNUM , D.GUBUN1 AS GRADE_NM , CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '출고' THEN A.OCHAGAM ELSE A.ICHAGAM END AS CHAGAM_WEIGHT , CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.IWEIGHT ELSE A.OWEIGHT END AS ACPT_WEIGHT , A.CUSTOMWEIGHT AS COMP_WEIGHT , A.LOSSWEIGHT AS LOSS_WEIGHT , CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN D.DANGA ELSE D.SELLPRC2 END AS STD_UNIT_PRC , CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.IDANGA ELSE A.ODANGA END AS APPLY_UNIT_PRC , D.DANGA - (CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.IDANGA ELSE A.ODANGA END ) AS DIFF_UNIT_PRC , A.TRANSPORTKUMAK , ISNULL(ROUND(A.TRANSPORTKUMAK / ISNULL(F.DANJUNG, CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.IWEIGHT ELSE A.OWEIGHT END), 1), 0) AS CRY_UNIT_PRC FROM MESURING A LEFT OUTER JOIN ACC_DEALER_CD B ON(CASE A.KERATYPE WHEN '입고' THEN A.MAIPCHERID WHEN '출고' THEN A.J_ASSIGNID END) = B.DEALER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN JAJAE D ON A.J_SERIAL = D.J_SERIAL LEFT OUTER JOIN INLIST F ON(CASE A.KERATYPE WHEN '입고' THEN A.IPCHULGO_MAIPID WHEN '출고' THEN A.IPCHULGO_MACHULID END) = F.J_ID WHERE A.J_DATE = #{FDATE} AND A.KERATYPE != '직송' AND B.DEALER_CD != 6303870006 --재고이동 제외 AND D.DAEGUBUN IN ('고철A', '고철B', '슈레더') AND A.J_SERIAL NOT IN ('4049042', '5050042') -- 반품제외
AND (CASE A.KERATYPE WHEN '입고' THEN A.MAIPCHER WHEN '출고' THEN A.J_COMPANY END) LIKE '%'+#{findWord}+'%'
AND ((#{CHKYN} = 'ALL' AND 1 = 1) OR(#{CHKYN} = 'Y' AND (A.IDANGA > 0 OR A.ODANGA > 0)) OR(#{CHKYN} = 'N' AND A.IDANGA = 0 AND A.ODANGA = 0))
AND A.KERATYPE = #{INOUT} AND ((#{CHKYN} = 'ALL' AND 1 = 1) OR(#{CHKYN} = 'Y' AND A.IDANGA > 0) OR(#{CHKYN} = 'N' AND A.IDANGA = 0))
AND A.KERATYPE = #{INOUT} AND ((#{CHKYN} = 'ALL' AND 1 = 1) OR(#{CHKYN} = 'Y' AND A.ODANGA > 0) OR(#{CHKYN} = 'N' AND A.ODANGA = 0))
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TEMP1) AS CNT , ROWNUM , JUNPYOID , KERATYPE , SUN --순번 , ISNULL(DEALER_NM,'') AS DEALER_NM --거래처명 , ISNULL(J_BNUM,'') AS J_BNUM --차번 , ISNULL(GRADE_NM,'') AS GRADE_NM --등급 , ISNULL(FORMAT(CHAGAM_WEIGHT , '#,0'),'') AS CHAGAM_WEIGHT --감량중량 , ISNULL(FORMAT(ACPT_WEIGHT , '#,0'),'') AS ACPT_WEIGHT --인수량 , ISNULL(FORMAT(COMP_WEIGHT , '#,0'),'') AS COMP_WEIGHT --업체중량 , ISNULL(FORMAT(LOSS_WEIGHT , '#,0'),'') AS LOSS_WEIGHT --Loss중량 , ISNULL(FORMAT(STD_UNIT_PRC , '#,0'),'') AS STD_UNIT_PRC --기준단가 , ISNULL(FORMAT(APPLY_UNIT_PRC , '#,0'),'') AS APPLY_UNIT_PRC --적용단가 , ISNULL(FORMAT(DIFF_UNIT_PRC , '#,0'),'') AS DIFF_UNIT_PRC --차액 , ISNULL(FORMAT(TRANSPORTKUMAK , '#,0'),'') AS TRANSPORTKUMAK --운반비 , ISNULL(FORMAT(CRY_UNIT_PRC , '#,0'),'') AS CRY_UNIT_PRC --운반비단가 FROM TEMP1 ORDER BY ROWNUM OFFSET (#{pageNum}-1)*#{pageLength} ROW FETCH NEXT #{pageLength} ROW ONLY
